question: What alternative timing is permitted for preparing the speaker's kuśa brush?
premises: The end of a month is specified as a time.
The particle vā introduces an alternative timing.
Preparing a kuśa brush is the prescribed action.
inference: The kuśa brush may be prepared at the end of a month as an alternative occasion.
uncertainties: The alternative to which māsa+ante is contrasted is not explicitly stated in this verse.
plain_english: Or, O great goddess, my beautiful one, one should make the kuśa brush at the end of the month.
